inputs.causal_hypothesis: Data-centre load growth and inadequate grid capacity can increase utility transmission, substation, distribution, interconnection, and critical-path electrical-construction demand served by Quanta, subject to permitting, project timing, labor, fixed-price execution, policy, and valuation.
inputs.research_focus: Validate identity, transmission and substation demand, data-centre electrical-installation exposure, backlog quality, labor and contract risks, cash conversion, valuation, catalysts, and invalidation.

objective: Research Quanta Services as a bounded grid-interconnection and data-centre electrical-construction exposure.
